name: Two MA Other TimeFrame Correct Intersection
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of two Moving Averages calculated from a different (higher) timeframe than the chart it runs on. It correctly handles multi-timeframe MA alignment by using bar synchronization to avoid repainting, entering long on bullish cross and short on bearish cross, with optional stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两个不同周期移动平均线在另一个（更高）时间框架上的交叉信号进行交易。它通过K线同步正确处理多周期MA对齐问题以避免重绘，在金叉时做多、死叉时做空，并支持可选的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双均线交叉，但与传统双均线EA不同的是，该EA在当前图表周期上运行，却使用更高时间框架（如H1、H4）的MA数据进行信号判断。入场条件为：当高周期快线上穿慢线时开多单，当快线下穿慢线时开空单。关键技术点在于'正确交叉'——通过精确的K线时间同步，确保高周期MA值在当前周期上不发生重绘，即只在对应高周期K线收盘确认后才触发信号。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号平仓，或通过预设的止损止盈参数退出。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，止损和止盈为可选参数，若不设置则完全依赖信号反转平仓，存在较大风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual moving average crossover, but unlike conventional MA crossover EAs, this one runs on the current chart timeframe while using MA data from a higher timeframe (e.g., H1, H4) for signal generation. Entry conditions are: go long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA on the higher timeframe, and go short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. The key technical feature is 'correct intersection' — through precise bar time synchronization, it ensures that higher-timeframe MA values do not repaint on the current chart, meaning signals only trigger after the corresponding higher-timeframe bar closes and confirms. Exit conditions rely on opposite crossover signals to close positions, or through optional stop loss and take profit parameters. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic sizing mechanism. Money management is limited — stop loss and take profit are optional parameters, and if not set, the EA fully relies on signal reversal for exits, creating a significant risk exposure.

pros: 正确处理多周期MA同步问题，避免了常见的重绘陷阱，信号更加可靠
使用更高时间框架信号可以过滤掉低周期的噪音，提高交易质量
逻辑清晰简洁，参数较少，便于理解和调优
同时支持做多和做空，在趋势市场中具有双向获利能力
pros_en: Correctly handles multi-timeframe MA synchronization, avoiding the common repainting trap and producing more reliable signals
Using higher timeframe signals filters out lower-timeframe noise, improving trade quality
Clear and concise logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
Supports both long and short positions, enabling profitability in trending markets in both directions
cons: 固定手数没有动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金或波动率自适应调整
止损止盈为可选且默认关闭，若用户未手动设置则风险敞口极大
缺乏新的K线检查机制，可能在同一根高周期K线内重复开仓
没有过滤机制（如ADX趋势强度、成交量确认等），在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号频繁交易
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing with no dynamic position management, unable to adapt based on account equity or volatility
Stop loss and take profit are optional and disabled by default, creating extreme risk exposure if users don't set them manually
Lacks a new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same higher-timeframe bar
No filtering mechanism (e.g., ADX trend strength, volume confirmation), prone to false signals and frequent trading in ranging markets
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额或ATR自动计算手数
添加新K线检查机制，确保每个高周期K线只交易一次
增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期趋势判断），减少震荡市中的虚假信号
默认启用止损，并添加追踪止损功能以保护利润
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that calculates lot size based on account balance or ATR
Implement a new bar check to ensure only one trade per higher-timeframe bar
Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe trend confirmation) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Enable stop loss by default and add a trailing stop feature to protect profits

risk_points: 止损止盈默认关闭，若未手动设置则完全依赖信号反转，可能造成大幅亏损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，增加风险敞口
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能因单笔交易过大而快速爆仓
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are disabled by default; without manual setup, the EA relies entirely on signal reversal, potentially causing large drawdowns
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position openings in the same direction, increasing risk exposure
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size, so small accounts could blow up quickly from oversized single trades
